title: Sanctum Ground Truth Annotation
description: Schema for PII ground-truth annotation files that accompany test fixture documents.

generator.description: Script or method that produced this document.

seed.description: Random seed used for reproducibility (null if not applicable).

entities.description: List of PII entity annotations with exact character offsets.

entity_type.description: Presidio entity type, e.g. PERSON, EMAIL_ADDRESS, US_SSN.

start.description: Start character offset (inclusive) in the .txt file.

end.description: End character offset (exclusive) in the .txt file.

text.description: The literal PII text that appears at [start:end].

context.description: Surrounding text snippet for human review.

expected_counts.description: Mapping of entity_type to expected occurrence count.
